minutes.headline: Building committee heard a roof snow-protection fix funded from the GMP credit and a closeout update on the on-time project.
minutes.summary: The School Building Committee met for what the chair called likely its last in-person meeting. It heard about snow sliding off the membrane roof and a proposed protective system, a parking lot drainage fix, the basketball court schedule, and the MSBA closeout timeline. Members thanked the team and adjourned.

what_happened.line: The committee proceeded, absent objection, with a proposed system to stop snow sliding off the membrane roof; the vote was not audible.
The fix was proposed to be paid from the GMP, using the credit received from the abatement, and not by change order.
A quote existed for the protective system's materials; labor and installation costs were still being worked out.
The committee heard that the project was delivered on time and that the parking lot drain fix may be absorbed by contingency.
The presenter reviewed the MSBA maximum local share and state share after change orders; reconciliation was ongoing.

why_it_matters: The roof fix is to be paid from an existing credit within the project budget instead of a change order, which keeps it from adding to the cost the town and state share.
Final local and state shares were still being reconciled, so the town's closing cost for the school building was not yet settled.
